objections.claim: Cloud Run instances cold starts and sudden traffic surges can cause dropped requests during follow-the-sun handoff peaks.
objections.failure_scenario: During sudden handoff peaks between APAC and EMEA time zones, rapid container scaling causes cold start latencies exceeding 2 seconds and connection pool exhaustion on the primary datastore.
objections.recommended_mitigation: Configure minimum warm instances (min-instances=1) and tune connection pooling limits.

objections.claim: Single-zone Cloud SQL outage halts all global task CRUD operations violating 99% availability and RTO <= 1 hour.
objections.failure_scenario: A physical datacenter disruption in primary zone causes primary database unavailability.
objections.recommended_mitigation: Enable Cloud SQL Regional High Availability (HA) with automatic synchronous multi-zone failover.
